articles.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
articles.summary: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

articles.title: From restaurant guides to payments, here’s how TikTok is building a super app
articles.summary: TikTok may be working to become the app that people use for most of their digital activities.

articles.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
articles.summary: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

articles.title: Bitcoin held up better than expected after Binance hack, Strive CEO says
articles.summary: Strive CEO Matt Cole says the Binance hack has not changed his long-term case for Bitcoin, but cautions it is too early to call a market bottom.

articles.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
articles.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.
